basis: These exact images were opened with read_image during manual review; final hashes must match the reviewed baseline or be inspected again.
observations: All three main viewport images show the balance, points action, pet actions and navigation within the viewport.
Picker counts and paging, editor fields, saved amounts and user facts remain visible; the complete sentinel reason is retained in the form and records.
Reminder acknowledgement, date and time, ordinary versus event selection, and user notes remain distinct.
Reward request shows object, cost, balance equation, zero request debit and parent approval; confirmation retains the user note.
Care UI shows shared free allowance, family date, action completion, inventory source/count, and explicit reward state.
Growth stages show reached/current/locked states and numeric thresholds; profile and preferences retain factual controls and capability states.
Narrow authorization uses a scrollable body and a reachable fixed footer; buying two items shows 3×2=6 and 123−6=117.
Wrong PIN and backend rejection show distinct concise states with concrete retry or edit controls.
